name: @jkidd/ui
description: JKidd UI: the component library, React components with their CSS, in two lanes. Postcards (src/postcards): marks, card parts, the dressing shapes, the stick figure, the card frame and the six archetypes, drawn at the Figma canvas size and scaled. Web (src/web): the controls and the page compositions, drawn at web size and reflowed. And what both share: the fonts, and the Foundations imagery (./imagery/*, one file each: the card stocks, paper and palm sky, the portrait, the western press).
